hero.subtitle: Track your mood, complete healing exercises, and connect with mental health experts — all in one warm, hand-crafted platform.

howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, no pressure — every small step matters.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your profile in 2 minutes. Pick a cute Paper Flow avatar and share what kind of support you need.
howItWorks.step2Desc: A 30-second daily check-in. AI analyzes and understands how you're feeling.
howItWorks.step3Desc: AI suggests exercises that fit you. Meditation, breathing, journaling — every step earns XP.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Track your progress, earn badges, and connect with an expert when you need deeper support.

features.moodDesc: PeaceCat AI listens and analyzes your mood through emoji, sliders, and natural conversation. Detects early warning signs.
features.tasksDesc: 80+ exercises from easy to hard. Meditation, breathing, journaling, social connection — every completion earns XP and badges.
features.expertsDesc: 30+ certified mental health experts. Chat, voice, or video call — book in 2 minutes.
features.testsDesc: DASS-21, GAD-7, PHQ-9, PSQI — clinical psychological scales presented in a friendly, pressure-free way.
features.journalDesc: A private space, AES-256 encrypted. AI analyzes your emotions and offers gentle suggestions after each entry.
features.emergencyDesc: Automatic detection of danger keywords. Instant grounding exercises, a free hotline, and immediate expert connection.

moodDemo.trackDesc: Your mood is saved as a chart so you can look back on your self-healing journey.

footer.brandDesc: A mental health support platform that helps you get through stress and find peace every day through fun, gamified exercises.
